metaDescription: Kevin reviews Pope Leo XIV's AI encyclical Magnifica Humanitatis, the Vatican-Anthropic ethics tie-up, and why religions may see AI as a rival.
summary: This video is Kevin's reaction to the Pope's encyclical on artificial intelligence, Magnifica Humanitatis, and the Vatican's AI ethics agreement with Anthropic. Kevin argues religions may view AI as a threat because people could place faith in it. He summarizes the encyclical's chapters, including its Babel versus Nehemiah framing, its critique of transhumanism, and its warnings about truth, work, and war. Kevin agrees AI is cultivated rather than built and calls AI a tool shaped by its wielders, but disagrees on work and attention. He also discusses Peter Thiel's reported Antichrist comments.
